$schema.description: Where the JSON Schema for this version lives.

version.description: Semver; minor versions only add optional fields.

generator.description: App name and version that wrote the file.

units.description: Units for every number in the file; consumers must read this, never assume.

frames.description: Handedness and axis conventions, gravity in the part frame, and where the part sits in the cell.

part.description: Source file name, SHA-256, source units and scale, triangle and body counts, bounding box.

cleanEveryS.description: Arc time between torch cleaning stops in seconds, 0 for none. Absent in files written before cleaning was modelled.

cleanTimeS.description: Duration of one torch cleaning stop in seconds.

weldToleranceRel.description: Vertex weld tolerance as a fraction of the part bounding box diagonal; the seams were detected on the part welded at it. Absent in files written before it was stored, which used 1e-5.

settings.description: Detection and export settings used, so the file is reproducible.

baseMaterial.description: Material spec and the thickness range in mm this procedure covers.

wire.description: Filler classification and diameter in mm.

gas.description: Shielding gas mix and flow in L/min.

electrical.description: Current in A, voltage in V, wire feed speed in m/min, polarity.

ctwdMm.description: Contact tip to work distance in mm, null when not applicable.

torch.description: Work angle offset from the bisector in degrees, travel angle, push or drag.

weave.description: Pattern, amplitude in mm, frequency in Hz, dwell at the edges in ms.

arcEnd.description: Crater fill in seconds, burnback in ms, post-flow in seconds.

positions.description: ISO 6947 positions this procedure is valid for.

thermalEfficiency.description: Process factor k used for heat input.

interpassMaxC.description: Maximum interpass temperature in degrees C.

procedures.description: Reusable weld procedures referenced by seams.

procedureId.description: Id of the procedure to use.

positions.description: ISO 6947 positions this procedure is valid for.

overrides.description: Per-seam changes to the procedure, same keys as a procedure.

throatMm.description: Fillet throat in mm, 0.707 x leg for equal legs.

passes.description: One entry per pass with lateral and vertical offsets and work-angle change.

intermittent.description: null for continuous, or segment length and pitch.

boxing.description: Wrap around the start and/or end, with length.

closed.description: True for a loop, false for an open chain.

direction.description: Direction relative to the stored points.

geometry.description: Opening angle, the two plate normals, plate thickness behind each normal, start and end points.

position.description: AWS and ISO 6947 position plus the two angles they were computed from.

poses.description: s is arc length in mm; position is the TCP at the weld root in the part frame; quaternion is the tool orientation, x,y,z,w.

approach.description: Distance along minus tool z before arc start.

retract.description: Distance along minus tool z after arc end.

sensing.description: Touch-sensing searches (direction and distance) and seam tracking mode.

access.description: Free-cone clearance, class, port, reach coverage 0 to 1, unreachable arc-length intervals.

estimates.description: Arc time, heat input, wire mass, gas volume for this seam.

warnings.description: Seam-level warnings carried into the file.

points.description: The seam polyline with frames, unrounded, so the plan can be restored exactly.

seams.description: Every accepted seam, in no particular order.

sequence.description: Strategy used, ordered seam list with direction, air moves.

access.description: Access ports and snake-arm parameters used for reach analysis.

cycleTimeS.description: Arc time, air time, arc start and end times and torch cleaning stops.

torchCleanings.description: Number of torch cleaning stops in the cycle time.

cleaningTimeS.description: Total time of the torch cleaning stops, included in cycleTimeS.

validation.description: Pre-flight errors (must be empty to export) and warnings, each with code, seamId and message.
